cohort: The study included 50 term infants with perinatal asphyxia (33 without HIE, 7 with HIE1, and 10 with HIE2) treated at Helsinki University Hospital's neonatal units.
finding: Most infants with perinatal asphyxia, with or without HIE, presented atypical neurological findings in sequential examinations, and white matter T2 hyperintensity was associated with atypical spontaneous movements.
